books.title: Online Learning Book
books.summary: Orabona v10 shares one canonical Lean library: Chapter 1 foundations, extended convexity, closure constructions and supporting gradients, projected OGD with fixed or decreasing steps, and subsequent bounded Chapter 2 packages. Probability, EXP3 and Tsallis references remain shared. Chapter 2 and the Chapters 1-16 program remain incomplete. Constrained optimality, signed-integral foundations and the qualified Jensen theorem are separately integrated into this shared library; their bounded scopes do not complete Chapter 2. A generalized Lemma4.2 forward dependency now strengthens one supplied local continuous-linear support by the exact quadratic term, using an internally constructed affine tilt and the shared minimum-growth theorem. Support existence, vector/chosen-norm transport, the full iff, attainment and corrected FTRL/BTRL bounds remain open; Chapter2 is partial with seven forward containers, six future claims and null complete proof denominator. A subsequent bounded coordinate-adapter proposal addresses the earlier vector/chosen-norm interface gap: a supplied global source vector becomes a continuous linear functional through an arbitrary algebraic coordinate equivalence, while the strong-convexity penalty retains the original E norm. Its experimental proof genuinely reuses support growth; canonical installation and acceptance remain pending. Full iff, support existence, attainment, actual cumulative producers and corrected FTRL/BTRL bounds remain open. A further bounded cumulative-producer proposal constructs properness, exact feasible domain and strong curvature from a strongly convex real regularizer and convex finite loss components. Its two experimental consumers reuse supplied-support growth at nonminimizing basepoints. This sufficient componentwise branch leaves general cumulative objectives, attainment, stability and full FTRL/BTRL guarantees open; canonical and reader acceptance remain pending. A further bounded full-iff proposal restores both directions of Lemma4.2 under its actual all-point global support premise, internally derives feasible finiteness and preserves the original chosen norm. Its converse consumer and missing-support counterexample expose the premise and the printed proof equality correction. Canonical/reader acceptance and general support existence, attainment and corrected FTRL/BTRL performance remain pending. A bounded cumulative optimistic-stability proposal now derives support for the actual current total objective from the prediction minimum and local loss-minus-hint support, then obtains the sharp original-norm quadratic bound. Its tight nonminimum consumer distinguishes the two objectives. Canonical/reader acceptance, dual-norm optimization, attainment and corrected full FTRL/BTRL performance remain pending. A positive-curvature dual-norm stability proposal now optimizes the actual sharp bound using the operator norm and a completed square. A tight nonminimum consumer and a zero-curvature counterexample separate its guarantee from attainment and full regret. Canonical and reader acceptance remain pending. An appendix Weierstrass dependency proposal now maps compact extended-real attainment with the exact Hausdorff, global lower-semicontinuity and domain-intersection assumptions. Its constant-bottom consumer preserves the permitted negative-infinite minimum. Strong-convex attainment and canonical/reader acceptance remain pending.
